data: In fiscal 2025 (the year ended September 27, 2025), Apple reported net sales of $416.161 billion, gross profit (which Apple labels "gross margin") of $195.201 billion, and operating income of $133.050 billion. That works out to a gross margin of about 46.9% of revenue and an operating margin of about 32.0%. Both improved from fiscal 2024, when gross profit was $180.683 billion on $391.035 billion of sales (46.2%) and operating income was $123.216 billion (31.5%). Operating expenses were $62.151 billion in fiscal 2025, made up of $34.550 billion in research and development and $27.601 billion in selling, general and administrative costs.
